perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Subsistence
enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.name: Slice
perks.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

enhanced.name: Slice
enhanced.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for an improved duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.description: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Offhand Strike
enhanced.description: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for an improved duration.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.description: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

enhanced.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
enhanced.description: Rapidly improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

enhanced.name: Perpetual Motion
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion for a short duration.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.description: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

enhanced.name: Zen Moment
enhanced.description: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time. Improves base stability.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Killing Tally
perks.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

enhanced.name: Killing Tally
enhanced.description: Final blows increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded. Improves magazine size.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.description: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

enhanced.name: Target Lock
enhanced.description: Damage increases by an improved amount the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.description: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

enhanced.name: Tap the Trigger
enhanced.description: Grants an improved short period of greatly increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

enhanced.name: Kill Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after defeating a target grants increased damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

enhanced.name: Attrition Orbs
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage creates a slightly improved Orb of Power.

perks.name: Encore
perks.description: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

enhanced.name: Encore
enhanced.description:
Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.
Effect duration is improved.
